question: What will be the highest price Amazon (AMZN) trades at over the next 3 years (by August 2029)?
additional_context: Resolution: the highest daily closing price of Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN) common stock recorded on any trading day between 12 August 2026 and 31 August 2029 inclusive, split-adjusted to the share basis in effect on 12 August 2026. Note this is a RUNNING MAXIMUM over a three-year window, not the price on a single resolution date: the outcome is bounded below by the price on the first day of the window, so it can only be at or above the current level. Current anchor: AMZN traded at $272.27 on 12 August 2026 (previous close $278.09; 52-week range $196.00-$287.20; market capitalisation about $3.0 trillion). Because the maximum only ratchets upward, assign probability across the bins for how far ABOVE the current $272 level the peak print gets over three years, not for whether the stock ends higher or lower. Treat the $400-500 bin as the central bin of the axis.
